Hi @james.brown@prada.com,

Following up once more on this ticket. We understand things can get busy, and it's also possible the issue may have resolved itself on your end, if that's the case, please let us know and we'll get this closed out for you.

If you're still experiencing the issue, we're standing by and ready to continue our investigation. Just reply here with any updates and we'll pick things right back up.

Thank you.

Hi @james.brown@prada.com,

I hope you're doing well! I wanted to send one last note regarding the ticket below before we wrap things up on our end. We've reached out a couple of times and haven't been able to connect, which makes us think things may have sorted themselves out, and we hope that's the case!

If everything is working as expected, no action is needed on your part. We'll go ahead and close this ticket out on friday 9th to keep your queue tidy. If the issue does pop back up after that, just open a new ticket and we'll jump right in.

If you're still running into trouble, please don't hesitate to reply here, we're still here and happy to help get things resolved.

Wishing you a great rest of your day!

Enrique Jimenez
